spec_text_or_path: Bladefall+Blade Blast's identity is a TWO-STAGE coupling via a shared consumable field. Bladefall PLANTS lingering blade-entities on the ground (econ_raw=field-resource-consume); Blade Blast CONSUMES that field — each blade a detonation, chaining across the field, up to 30 detonations/s emptying the queue. The blade count IS Blade Blast's damage budget. Engine placed entities (placed_lane, totem) are AUTONOMOUS colliders/proxies with duration expiry; no lane represents 'a placed-entity field that a SECOND skill spends as a consumable ammunition queue, where field size = the second skill's damage/duration budget.' Mapped as multi_projectile-seed -> ring detonation-cascade (GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade), which lands the plant-then-explode feel but loses the field-as-shared-resource that COUPLES the two buttons. Same FAMILY as batch-01 animate-weapon (ground-dropped-item-as-summon-fuel) and this batch's dark-pact (proxy-max-life-as-ammo): the recurring gap is 'entity-on-the-field as a consumable resource pool spent by another skill.' Would require either (a) a placed-entity-consumption resource primitive (field-count -> consuming-skill budget), or (b) a steward ruling that the field-substrate is flavor-only and the propagation-cascade approximation is canonical.

Dark Pact INVERTS the proxy pattern. Normal proxies (necro minions, totems) ATTACK autonomously and are sustained. Dark Pact instead CONSUMES its skeletons' MAX LIFE as the damage fuel for a chaining chaos nova — 'converts their maximum life into waves of chaos damage'; Minion Life supports scale YOUR damage BY raising the battery capacity; skeletons die rapidly and are constantly resummoned as ammunition. Engine PROXY family + resource_economy models proxies that attack + are sustained; no lane represents 'proxy max-life as a consumable ammo pool the caster spends per cast, whose capacity is scaled by minion-life gear.' hp_cost_scale carries the no-skeleton SELF-cost fallback (native), but the minion-as-battery core is unmapped. Mapped as chain-nova + totem-battery-field + minion-life-consume note (APPROX). Same FAMILY as batch-01 animate-weapon (ground-item-as-ammo) + this batch's bladefall (field-as-detonation-queue): recurring 'entity as a consumable resource pool spent by a skill' gap. Would require either (a) a proxy-life-consumption resource primitive (proxy pool -> caster damage), or (b) a ruling that the battery-inversion is flavor-only and the chain-nova + self-cost approximation is canonical. Steward may wish to consolidate the three-kit family into ONE 'entity-as-consumable-resource-pool' docket.
